transfer_finding: CLIP-surrogate perturbations generated against LLaVA-1.5-7B (CLIP ViT-L/14) fail to transfer to Qwen2.5-VL-7B (Custom ViT), confirming that pixel-space cross-modal adversarial attacks exhibit severe architectural non-transferability across disparate visual backbones.
